name: Gouda Studios Agent Tools
description: Agent-payable data tools (SAM.gov, SEC EDGAR, USAspending, GLEIF, website contact extractor, YouTube transcript extractor) via Apify's hosted MCP server.

authentication.description: Sign in with Apify OAuth (authorization server https://console-backend.apify.com) or send an Apify API token as Authorization: Bearer <token>. tools/list is open; tools/call returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate until authenticated.

tools.name: get-actor-run
tools.title: Get Actor run
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a specific Actor run.

Returns run result: status, storages (datasets/keyValueStores alias map), stats, summary, nextStep.
- summary describes the past (e.g. "SUCCEEDED in 22s. 47 items; 3 fields available.").
- nextStep prescribes one primary follow-up action with identifiers interpolated (e.g. "Use get-dataset-items with datasetId=...").
- waitSecs (0–45, default 30) waits up to that many seconds for terminal status before returning.

USAGE:
- Use to check the status of a run started by any Actor-running tool.
- Pass waitSecs > 0 to block until terminal (or until the cap elapses).

USAGE EXAMPLES:
- user_input: Show details of run y2h7sK3Wc
- user_input: Wait for run y2h7sK3Wc to finish

runId.description: The ID of the Actor run.

waitSecs.description:
Maximum seconds to wait for the run to reach a terminal state (SUCCEEDED, FAILED, ABORTED, TIMED-OUT).
0 returns immediately with the current status. Cap: 45. Default: 30.

tools.name: get-dataset-items
tools.title: Get dataset items
tools.description:
Get items (rows) from a dataset — the output/results produced by an Actor run.
Returns the rows themselves, not dataset metadata, counts, or a schema.
When the user provides a datasetId and asks to retrieve results, output, data, or rows, call this tool directly.
Default limit is 20. Use clean=true to skip empty items and hidden fields.

USAGE:
- Use when you need to read data from a dataset (all items or only selected fields).

USAGE EXAMPLES:
- user_input: Retrieve results from dataset abc123
- user_input: Get only metadata.url and title from dataset username~my-dataset

clean.description: If true, returns only non-empty items and skips hidden fields (starting with #). Shortcut for skipHidden=true and skipEmpty=true.

offset.description: Number of items to skip at the start. Default is 0.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Default is 20.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in results. Fields in output are sorted as specified. Use dot notation for nested objects (e.g. "metadata.url"); the server auto-flattens parent prefixes.

omit.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from results.

desc.description: If true, results are returned in reverse order (newest to oldest).

flatten.description: Comma-separated list of fields to flatten (e.g. flatten="metadata" turns {"metadata":{"url":"x"}} into {"metadata.url":"x"}). Normally derived automatically from dot-notation in `fields`; specify only as a diagnostic override.

tools.name: get-key-value-store-record
tools.title: Get key-value store record
tools.description:
Get the value stored under a specific key in a key-value store — a single record, not a listing of all keys.
Requires the exact key name.
The response preserves the original Content-Encoding; most clients handle decompression automatically.

USAGE:
- Use when you need to retrieve a specific record (JSON, text, or binary) from a store.

USAGE EXAMPLES:
- user_input: Get record INPUT from store abc123
- user_input: Get record data.json from store username~my-store

recordKey.description: Key of the record to retrieve.

tools.name: abort-actor-run
tools.title: Abort Actor run
tools.description:
Abort an Actor run that is currently starting or running.
For runs with status SUCCEEDED, FAILED, ABORTING, ABORTED, or TIMED-OUT, this call has no effect.
The results will include the updated run details after the abort request.

USAGE:
- Use when you need to stop a run that is taking too long or misconfigured.

USAGE EXAMPLES:
- user_input: Abort run y2h7sK3Wc
- user_input: Gracefully abort run y2h7sK3Wc

runId.description: The ID of the Actor run to abort.

gracefully.description: If true, the Actor run will abort gracefully with a 30-second timeout.

tools.name: gouda_studios--sam-gov-opportunities-feed
tools.title: gouda_studios/sam-gov-opportunities-feed
tools.description:
This tool calls the Actor "gouda_studios/sam-gov-opportunities-feed" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Get new federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov as clean JSON, no API key needed. Filter by keyword, NAICS, set-aside, notice type, agency and state. Includes deadlines, days left and contracting officer contacts. Monitor mode returns only new notices.

inputSchema.title: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities Feed

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description:
Optional free-text search over SAM.gov notice titles and text, e.g. "cybersecurity" or "janitorial services". Leave empty to return all notices that match the other filters.
Example values: "software"

naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes
naicsCodes.description: Optional list of 6-digit NAICS industry codes (strings), e.g. ["541511","541512"]. A notice matches if it has any of them. Empty = all industries.

items.title: NAICS codes
items.description: Optional list of 6-digit NAICS industry codes (strings), e.g. ["541511","541512"]. A notice matches if it has any of them. Empty = all industries.

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: Optional list of notice type codes: o=Solicitation, k=Combined Synopsis/Solicitation, p=Presolicitation, r=Sources Sought, s=Special Notice, a=Award Notice, u=Justification, i=Intent to Bundle, g=Surplus sale. Empty = all types.

setAsides.title: Set-asides
setAsides.description: Optional small-business set-aside codes, e.g. ["SBA","8A","SDVOSBC","WOSB","HZC"]. Empty = any set-aside or none.

states.title: Place of performance (state codes)
states.description: Optional 2-letter US state codes for the place of performance, e.g. ["VA","MD"]. Requires includeDetails=true. Empty = all locations.

items.title: Place of performance (state codes)
items.description: Optional 2-letter US state codes for the place of performance, e.g. ["VA","MD"]. Requires includeDetails=true. Empty = all locations.

agencyContains.title: Agency contains
agencyContains.description: Optional case-insensitive text the agency path must contain, e.g. "Navy" or "Veterans Affairs".

postedWithinDays.title: Posted/updated within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only notices posted or updated in the last N days. 0 = no date limit. Use 1-7 for daily/weekly monitoring.

minDaysUntilResponse.title: Minimum days until response deadline
minDaysUntilResponse.description: Optional. Skip notices whose response deadline is fewer than N days away, so you only get ones you can still bid on.

activeOnly.title: Active notices only
activeOnly.description:
true (default) = skip archived/inactive notices.
Example values: true

includeDetails.title: Fetch full details
includeDetails.description:
true (default) = fetch each notice for NAICS, PSC, set-aside, place of performance, full description and contacts. false = faster, fewer fields.
Example values: true

includeContacts.title: Include contracting officer contacts
includeContacts.description:
true (default) = include the contracting officer work name, email and phone published on the notice.
Example values: true

onlyNew.title: Only new since last run (monitor mode)
onlyNew.description: true = return only notices not delivered in an earlier run with the same filters (state is kept between runs). Use with a schedule for an alert feed.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description:
Maximum rows to return (1-10000). You are charged per row returned, so this caps the cost: 100 rows = $0.20 at $0.002/row.
Example values: 100

apiKey.title: SAM.gov API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free api.sam.gov public API key; when set, the Actor reads the official SAM.gov Opportunities API instead of the public search feed.

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

inputSchema.description: Returns U.S. federal contract opportunities (RFPs, RFQs, sources sought, award notices) from SAM.gov as one JSON row per notice. All inputs are optional; a good default is {"keywords":"software","postedWithinDays":7,"maxResults":50}. Pricing: pay per event, $0.002 per opportunity row returned.

tools.name: gouda_studios--sec-edgar-filings-feed
tools.title: gouda_studios/sec-edgar-filings-feed
tools.description:
This tool calls the Actor "gouda_studios/sec-edgar-filings-feed" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Monitor SEC EDGAR filings by ticker or CIK, including 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, Form 4 insider trades, Form D and S-1. Each result has the company, form type, filing date and document links. Only-new mode turns it into an alert feed for investors, research and AI agents.

inputSchema.title: SEC EDGAR Filings Feed: 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, Form 4, Form D, S-1
inputSchema.description: Returns SEC EDGAR filings as one JSON row per filing, from official sec.gov / data.sec.gov endpoints. With tickers or CIKs it reads each company's filing history; with neither it returns the latest market-wide filings of the chosen form types. Example: {"tickers":["AAPL","TSLA"],"formTypes":["8-K","10-Q"],"filedWithinDays":30}. Pricing: $0.002 per filing row.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description:
Optional stock tickers, e.g. ["AAPL","NVDA"]. Resolved to CIKs with the SEC ticker file.
Example values: ["AAPL","TSLA"]

items.title: Tickers
items.description: Optional stock tickers, e.g. ["AAPL","NVDA"]. Resolved to CIKs with the SEC ticker file.

ciks.title: CIK numbers
ciks.description: Optional SEC Central Index Keys, e.g. ["320193"]. Leave tickers and CIKs empty to get latest filings across all companies.

items.title: CIK numbers
items.description: Optional SEC Central Index Keys, e.g. ["320193"]. Leave tickers and CIKs empty to get latest filings across all companies.

formTypes.title: Form types
formTypes.description:
Form types to include, e.g. ["8-K","10-K","10-Q","4","D","S-1","13F-HR","SC 13D"]. Empty = all forms (company mode only; market-wide mode needs at least one).
Example values: ["8-K"]

items.title: Form types
items.description: Form types to include, e.g. ["8-K","10-K","10-Q","4","D","S-1","13F-HR","SC 13D"]. Empty = all forms (company mode only; market-wide mode needs at least one).

filedWithinDays.title: Filed within (days)
filedWithinDays.description:
Only filings from the last N days. 0 = no limit (company mode returns the ~1000 most recent).
Example values: 7

onlyNew.title: Only new since last run
onlyNew.description: true = skip filings delivered by an earlier run with the same tickers/CIKs/forms. Use with a schedule for an alert feed.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description:
Maximum rows (1-5000). You pay per row, so this caps cost: 100 rows = $0.20.
Example values: 100

contactEmail.title: Contact email for SEC User-Agent
contactEmail.description: Optional. SEC asks automated clients to identify themselves; this email is sent in the User-Agent header to sec.gov only.

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

tools.name: gouda_studios--gleif-company-lei-lookup
tools.title: gouda_studios/gleif-company-lei-lookup
tools.description:
This tool calls the Actor "gouda_studios/gleif-company-lei-lookup" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Find any company LEI number by name, or look up an LEI, in the official GLEIF global registry. Get the legal name, status, jurisdiction, registration number, legal and HQ address, and direct and ultimate parent companies. For KYC, KYB, vendor checks and data enrichment.

inputSchema.title: Company Lookup by Name or LEI: Legal Entity, Address, Parent (GLEIF)
inputSchema.description: Looks up legal entities worldwide in the official GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) database and returns one JSON row per matched company with legal name, status, address, registration number and parent companies. Example: {"companyNames":["Apple Inc."],"country":"US"} or {"leis":["HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394"]}. Pricing: $0.003 per company row.

companyNames.title: Company names
companyNames.description:
Legal names to look up, e.g. ["Apple Inc.","Siemens AG"]. Exact legal name match first, then fuzzy full-text.
Example values: ["Apple Inc."]

items.title: Company names
items.description: Legal names to look up, e.g. ["Apple Inc.","Siemens AG"]. Exact legal name match first, then fuzzy full-text.

items.title: LEI codes
items.description: Optional 20-character LEIs to fetch directly.

registrationNumbers.title: Registration numbers
registrationNumbers.description: Optional company-registry numbers as reported to GLEIF (registeredAs), e.g. a UK Companies House number.

items.title: Registration numbers
items.description: Optional company-registry numbers as reported to GLEIF (registeredAs), e.g. a UK Companies House number.

country.title: Country
country.description: Optional ISO 2-letter country of the legal address, e.g. US, GB, DE. Improves name matching.

activeOnly.title: Active entities only
activeOnly.description:
true (default) = skip lapsed/inactive entities for name and registration searches.

maxMatchesPerName.title: Max matches per name
maxMatchesPerName.description:

includeParents.title: Include parent companies
includeParents.description:
true (default) = add direct and ultimate parent (LEI, name, country) where reported.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description:
Maximum rows overall (1-5000). You pay per row: 100 rows = $0.30.
Example values: 100

tools.name: gouda_studios--website-contact-extractor
tools.title: gouda_studios/website-contact-extractor
tools.description:
This tool calls the Actor "gouda_studios/website-contact-extractor" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Email extractor and contact scraper for lead gen. Give it any list of websites and get emails, phones, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok links and addresses, one deduplicated row per site. Cloudflare emails decoded, phones validated. Pay only for sites where contacts are found.

startUrls.title: Websites
startUrls.description:
**REQUIRED** Websites or domains to extract contacts from, one per line. Examples: https://www.example.com or example.com. Each site becomes exactly one output row.
Example values: ["https://apify.com","https://www.python.org"]

items.title: Websites
items.description: **REQUIRED** Websites or domains to extract contacts from, one per line. Examples: https://www.example.com or example.com. Each site becomes exactly one output row.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description:
How many pages to read on each site, starting with the homepage and then the most likely contact pages (Contact, About, Team, Impressum, Support). You pay per site, not per page, so higher values only cost more time.
Example values: 8

defaultCountry.title: Default phone country
defaultCountry.description:
Two-letter country code used to read local phone numbers that have no +country prefix, e.g. US, GB, DE, AU.
Example values: "US"

checkMx.title: Check email domains for MX records
checkMx.description:
Adds a free DNS check that each email domain can receive mail. Flags typos and dead domains.
Example values: true

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description:
Skip pages that a site's robots.txt asks crawlers not to visit.
Example values: true

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description:
Optional. Most business sites work without a proxy. Turn on Apify Proxy if many sites time out or block requests.
Example values: {"useApifyProxy":false}

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Whether to use Apify Proxy. Set this to false when you want to use custom proxy URLs.

apifyProxyGroups.title: Apify Proxy Groups
apifyProxyGroups.description:
Select specific Apify Proxy groups to use (e.g., RESIDENTIAL, DATACENTER).
**DATACENTER:**
The fastest and cheapest option. It uses datacenters to change your IP address. Note that there is a chance of being blocked because of the activity of other users.

**RESIDENTIAL:**
IP addresses located in homes and offices around the world. These IPs are the least likely to be blocked.

proxyUrls.description: List of custom proxy URLs to be used instead of the Apify Proxy.

items.title: Custom proxy URL
items.description: Custom proxy URL
